name: MikeB
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Asset: a single personalized fantasy board-game playing piece on a genuinely transparent background. Image 1 is the person's identity reference; preserve their recognizable face, hair, expression, and distinctive accessories. Image 2 is the existing game's art-style reference only: match its chunky dark brown outlines, clean hand-drawn 2D cartoon shapes, warm colors, limited cel shading, and readable friendly storybook fantasy feel. Make the rider's head large enough that the face is recognizable at small sizes, uncovered. One fully clothed person sitting on one animal mount; animal faces right in a side/three-quarter view while the rider's face turns slightly toward the viewer. Entire rider and animal completely in frame, including feet/tail, compact centered composition occupying most of a landscape 4:3 canvas with only 5% padding. No background, environment, label, letters, border, frame, UI, watermark, or second character. True alpha transparency, no checkerboard painted into image. Keep a consistent simple game-sprite style rather than a photorealistic face pasted onto a cartoon.
The rider is MikeB: the smiling fair-haired man in image 1, swept blond hair and recognizable face. Give him a turquoise medieval tunic inspired by his shirt, fully closed/clothed, and seat him on a sturdy friendly golden-brown GRYPHON, eagle head with gold beak and compact folded wings, lion-like hindquarters. Friendly confident expression.
